evidence_classification: Scientific evidence: peer-reviewed review, systematic review/meta-analysis, and classroom study.

sources.citation: Rohrer, D. (2012). Interleaving helps students distinguish among similar concepts. Educational Psychology Review, 24, 355–367.
sources.supports: Interleaving can aid discrimination among similar concepts, but the review cautions that evidence is limited.

sources.citation: Firth, J., Rivers, I., & Boyle, J. (2021). A systematic review of interleaving as a concept learning strategy. Review of Education, 9, 642–684.
sources.supports: Interleaving was most useful when differences were subtle; the evidence base was dominated by laboratory studies of university undergraduates.

sources.citation: Samani, J., & Pan, S. C. (2021). Interleaved practice enhances memory and problem-solving ability in undergraduate physics. npj Science of Learning, 6, 32.
sources.supports: In one undergraduate physics course, interleaved homework felt more difficult but led to better later performance on novel criterial-test problems.

claim_limits: The reel does not claim that interleaving is universally superior or that unrelated material should be randomly mixed.
The practical mini-set follows initial instruction and uses closely related problem types.
The reel makes no guarantee of scores or learning outcomes.
